description: Render an explicit list of saved cameras from one scene into an output directory.

cameras.description: Saved camera names to render in order. Use keyshot_list_cameras first when names are unknown.

format.description: Output image format. Defaults to PNG when omitted.

height.description: Render height in pixels. Overrides the selected quality preset when provided.

maxTimeSeconds.description: Maximum render time in seconds. Selects time-based rendering and cannot be combined with samples.

outputDir.description: Directory for generated render files. Relative paths resolve inside KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR; external paths are rejected by default.

overwrite.description: Whether existing image files may be replaced. Defaults to false.

qualityPreset.description: Render quality preset: preview (960x540, 16 samples), standard (1920x1080, 64 samples), or final (3840x2160, 256 samples).

samples.description: Maximum render samples. Cannot be combined with maxTimeSeconds and overrides preset sampling when provided.

scenePath.description: Absolute path to an existing KeyShot scene file to open. Input files may be outside the configured output directory.

width.description: Render width in pixels. Overrides the selected quality preset when provided.

name: keyshot_batch_render

data.description: Operation-specific structured result data, or null when unavailable.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason, or null after success.

errorCode.description: Stable error category for common failures.

keyshotStdoutTail.description: Truncated tail of KeyShot headless output for diagnostics.

ok.description: True when the requested operation completed successfully.

outputFiles.description: Absolute paths of images or scene files created by the operation.

suggestions.description: Actionable recovery steps for the user or agent.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions the user or agent should review.

title: Render selected cameras
